newsitem.title: USA: CMI Corp says strong Q2 likely on orders.
newsitem.headline: CMI Corp says strong Q2 likely on orders.

text.p: CMI Corp said it expects a strong second quarter as high order activity continues.

"Order activity continues to be high with strong shipments scheduled for the second quarter," said senior vice president and chief financial officer Jim Holland. "Our backlog is now about $44 million compared to about $22 million at this time last year.

"We expect orders to pick up more during the second quarter. In the first quarter, weather conditions slowed orders somewhat, particularly for concrete equipment. "Consequently, the outlook for the second quarter and the remainder of 1997 is positive. Therefore, we expect that the first quarter just ended will contribute less to the annual earnings and revenues than did the first quarter of 1996," said Holland.

CMI announced Thursday that revenues for the first quarter ended March 31, 1997 rose to $41.7 million, an increase of 14 percent from the prior year's first quarter revenues of $36.5 million. Net earnings were $1.4 million, or seven cents per share, compared to $2.1 million, or 10 cents per share in the prior year.
